description: Save one stage of your blueprint, in order: concept, features, pages, database, tech_spec, tasks. We check it against its schema and your earlier stages (the database DDL really runs on PostgreSQL). Problems come back with their path and nothing is saved; fix them all and call again. For tasks, send {"tasks": []} to let us build the list.

data.description: The stage JSON, shaped like the stage's schema in blueprint_method.

instance_id.description: Utility instance id from buy or list_utilities.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if your client cannot send it as an Authorization header; leave it out when your MCP app signed in.

stage.description: Stage name, in order: concept, features, pages, database, tech_spec, tasks.

name: blueprint_put_stage
title: Save a blueprint stage
